messages:
rachel: Quick follow-up to the tri-mode telemetry discussion. Need a compact proposal that avoids cardinality while still showing origin/fallback behavior. I sketched a compact enum set and header names.

sam: +1. Key constraints: metrics = low-cardinality; traces = richer but sampled & opt-in.

eli: Suggested tag set: hosting=HOSTED|DEDICATED|PRIVATE; path=PREFERRED|FALLBACK|DEGRADED; bucket=perf|balanced|accurate|other; fallback=none|capacity|compat|auth|quota; route_ver=v1|v2. Keep buckets finite.

mira (sec): Security: no tenant IDs in hosted metrics. Private deployments can include tenant context into their own telemetry. Any trace capturing payloads must be opt-in and stored in a customer-controlled audit sink when required.

sam: Propagation via headers at first runtime handoff. Draft headers:
X-RW-Hosting: DEDICATED
X-RW-Path: FALLBACK
X-RW-Bucket: perf
X-RW-Route-Ver: v2
X-RW-Fallback: capacity
X-RW-Telemetry-Sample: 1/1000

eli: Runtime keeps a mapping model_name -> bucket. New/unmapped models map to "other" and emit an ops alert. Exporter should coerce unexpected tag values to "other" to prevent explosion.

rachel: Precedence rules for multi-hop: hosting = first non-UNKNOWN; path = worst-seen (if any stage is FALLBACK, mark FALLBACK). That keeps dashboards from double-counting.

mira (sec): Add default trace payload TTL = 30 days and a retention exception workflow. I'll draft policy language for the RFC.

sam: I'll open a small PR for header emit and exporter normalization. ops-bot: ping me for the next deploy slot.

ops-bot: Reminder: runtime deploy window Fri 01:00-03:00 UTC. Tag @sam if you want it.

rachel: Action items: rachel update RFC with enums+headers; sam PR + tests; eli mapping table + alerting; mira telemetry policy. Will post updated RFC tomorrow.
